crossRefs.note: He carved cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold fitted on the engraved work.

translations.web: He carved cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold fitted on the engraved work.
translations.bsb: He carved into them cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, and he overlaid them with gold hammered evenly over the carvings.
translations.kjv: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.
translations.asv: And he carved thereon cherubim and palm-trees and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold fitted upon the graven work.
